meta.title: CallingSupportApp — open tools for Church units
meta.description: Open source app to organize the activities of a ward or branch: sign-ups, quotas, payments and lists for temple trips, camps and EnglishConnect. In English, Spanish and Portuguese.

hero.titleRest: your unit's activities in one place
hero.lead: CallingSupportApp helps the leaders of a ward or branch organize the temple trip, camps and EnglishConnect classes: sign-ups, quotas, payments and lists, with the care that members' data deserves.

notice.label: Notice
notice.unofficial: This is not an official website of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. It is a volunteer, community-built tool.
notice.memberTools: It does not replace Member Tools, the official app: it adds features that don't exist today.

modules.title: Modules
modules.lead: Each module is enabled per calling: every leader sees and does only what their calling allows.

users.title: Users and callings
users.body: Who can sign in and what they can see or do in each module, based on their calling and organization.

temple.title: Temple trip
temple.body: Public sign-up, quotas per ordinance and gender, transportation and lodging, payments, rooms and printable lists for the day of the trip.

camp.title: Camp
camp.body: Youth and leaders, each youth's fee, a packing list everyone checks off from their phone, and who brings the ward's shared equipment.

ec.title: EnglishConnect
ec.body: Cycles and groups by level with their location, day and time. Each student signs up and sees their group; each teacher sees only their own students.

data.title: Caring for members' data
data.lead: Church members' data must be handled with the utmost care and must never leak. That's why the project follows simple rules:
data.p0: We follow the Church's General Handbook (33.8): data is limited to what is needed, used only for the approved purpose, seen only by those who are authorized, and never used for personal, political or commercial purposes.
data.p1: We only handle data that each person provides themselves, with their consent, for a specific activity.
data.p2: Lists from the Church's official systems are never imported.
data.p3: Ordinances and health information are treated as sensitive data.
data.p4: Every activity has a retention period, and the data is deleted automatically when it ends.
data.p5: One installation per ward: each unit owns and is responsible for its data. There is no central server.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.lead: Every task is written so you can pick it up without having talked to anyone first.
contribute.s1: Pick an unassigned issue without the “bloqueado” (blocked) label.
contribute.s2: Comment /tomar on the issue: a bot assigns it to you and lets everyone know it is in progress.
contribute.s3: Stay within the issue's scope and verify by running it.
contribute.s4: Review your code with the repository's skill and open the pull request.

about.title: About the creator
about.p1: I'm Marco Antonio Bustillos Quiroz, a software developer from Ecuador. I graduated from Brigham Young University–Idaho (B.S. in Web Design and Development) and served a full-time mission in Paraguay.
about.p2: This project comes from something simple: building tools that help Church units. In 2022, when my stake was running EnglishConnect, I built an app to organize the groups, teachers and students; the EnglishConnect module grows out of that experience.
about.p3: It is not sponsored by any company. It's a personal, volunteer project, open for any ward to use and for anyone who wants to contribute.
